bbox_convention: xyxy, exclusive right/bottom, native source pixels
method: RGB color-line alpha estimate against inpainted local dark background; observed blur retained
limitations: Sources are ~330x176 cards: masks reproduce observed low-resolution silhouettes, not unavailable font detail. F/Q/X and ALBON are explicitly composed.

albon.construction: A,L,B,O,N from extracted atlas, one native pixel ink gap; no glyph dilation

F.construction: E lower bar removed, preserving its measured stem profile

Q.construction: O plus short original R diagonal stroke

X.construction: Source V diagonals compressed vertically and mirrored

atlas.advance_rule: Place each glyph at pen; next pen += advance; masks include two-pixel blur sidebearings. Advance gives a 1-pixel gap between 50%-alpha ink boxes.
